messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing an intermittent uptick in hallucinations on math and SQL extraction evals when we enable KV-split with the new AWQ-int8 hybrid profile. Repro steps + numbers below. @kevin @raj can you triage?

kevin: rough numbers? did this correlate with any rollout? :eyes:

maria: rolled compact-latency-v2 (AWQ+GPTQ blend) last night at ~23:00 UTC. Canary shows math exact-match down ~3pt, SQL table extraction F1 down ~5-6pt. Not huge but consistent across seeds.

raj: can you paste a couple failing examples and the exact cmd you used for the bakeoff?

maria: sure — sample failing prompts and outputs:
```
PROMPT: "Given list of numbers [10, 20, 30], compute average."
BASELINE (fp16): "Average = 20"
AWQ-int8+kv-split: "Average = 22"  <-- wrong

PROMPT: "SELECT name FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3"
BASELINE: returns correct 3 rows
AWQ-int8+kv-split: drops one column and returns wrong ordering sometimes
```

Repro command:
```bash
./bench/run_bakeoff \
  --model awq-int8-hybrid \
  --kv-split true \
  --profile compact-latency-v2 \
  --evalsets mathbench,sqltable \
  --seed 42 \
  --batch-shape auto
```

ci-bot: Canary run summary:
- baseline fp16: math EM 92.1, sql F1 88.6
- awq-int8-hybrid + kv-split: math EM 89.0, sql F1 82.3
- delta: math -3.1 EM, sql -6.3 F1

olivia: my guess: KV-split is changing KV cache boundaries for longer numeric tokens -> tokenization alignment shift. Also batch-shape auto might pad differently causing off-by-one in head offsets.

kevin: quick test idea: flip kv-split off in the same profile and rerun small sample. If it recovers, we bisect kv-split change. Also try padding-mode=left/right.

maria: starting canary now with kv-split=false and padding-mode=right, will run seeds 1,42,99.

maria: canary done — results:
- awq-int8-hybrid + kv-split=false: math EM 91.8, sql F1 87.4
- recovered ~2.8 EM on math and ~5.1 F1 on SQL compared to kv-split=true

maria: opening ticket INF-7321 with artifacts and failing examples. Proposed next steps: 1) revert kv-split in prod canary until root cause found, 2) add targeted tokenization alignment tests to our eval harness (numeric & long identifiers), 3) schedule kernel/kernel-selection audit with eng-runtime (possible off-by-one in KV offset computation).

kevin: agreed. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform. i'll take point on the kernel audit.

raj: i'll add numeric-token tests to the regular canary suite and run seed sweep. also will check tokenizer boundary behavior for AWQ caches.

maria: thanks — I'll attach raw traces and a tiny reproducer binary to the ticket. :bug:
